name: cim_plicity_ping
title: cim_plicity_ping
description: Health check for CIMPlicity AI. Returns { ok, app, tools }. Call first to verify connectivity before other tools.

name: ai_detection
title: ai_detection
description: Suggest Splunk field extractions for a raw log sample: props.conf-ready PCRE regexes with named capture groups, a suggested sourcetype and timestamp settings (time_format, time_prefix, max_timestamp_lookahead). Uses the app-configured AI provider with a local regex fallback. Returns { sourcetype, fields:[{name, regex}], combined_regex, time_format, time_prefix, max_timestamp_lookahead, source }.

selected_fields.description: Optional field names; when given, a combined_regex covering exactly these fields is built.

name: pii_detection
title: pii_detection
description: Detect PII in a raw log sample using scrubadub detectors (configured on the app's Configuration page) plus optional caller-supplied regex patterns. Returns { pii_results:[{type, text, score, start, end, field, examples, regex_pattern}], suggestion }.

text.description: Raw sample to scan for PII.

name: cim_mapping
title: cim_mapping
description: Map extracted log fields onto a Splunk CIM data model with AI, returning per-field confidence and reasoning. cimModel is a lowercase_underscore model key (e.g. authentication, network_traffic, web; loaded dynamically from Splunk_SA_CIM when installed). Returns [{field, cimField, confidence, reasoning}] or {error}. Requires the app's AI api_key to be configured.

extractedFields.description: Extracted fields, e.g. [{name, sample}]; sample values improve mapping quality.

cimModel.description: CIM model key, lowercase with underscores, e.g. authentication, network_traffic, web.
